title: Live Transcript Streaming During Recording
requirements: Replace the placeholder text "Live transcript will appear here…" with one of two visible states: (a) when live streaming is available, append partial transcript deltas into liveTranscript via appendTranscript; (b) when only full-file transcription is available, display the static message "Recording… transcription will start when you stop"

Make RecordingViewModel.appendTranscript(text:) callable from SpeechTranscriber streams (not test-only): if SpeechTranscriber exposes a streaming API, subscribe during recording and forward TranscriptUpdate.partial into liveTranscript
After stop(), the final transcript from service.transcribe replaces the live placeholder/deferred-text
The transcript area must be non-empty during an active recording — always shows either partial text or the deferred-transcription message
acceptance_criteria: During recording (>0s after start), the transcript area is non-empty with either partial text or the deferred-transcription message
The final transcript appears after stop within the pipeline completion window defined by transcription-post-recording-pipeline
The placeholder no longer persists forever after recording starts
out_of_scope: True streaming for Whisper (Whisper is a full-file engine)
